description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI skill icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, in this order left to right then top to bottom, each centered in its own cell: a wavy blue water spear with a rounded droplet head; a glowing green plus cross inside a clear water bubble; a cone-shaped fan of water spraying outward from one point; a soft grey cloud dropping short blue raindrops; a black storm cloud with two big yellow lightning bolts; a heavy iron anchor dripping with blue water; a blue water fang dripping one red drop; a small stone spring basin bubbling red and blue droplets; a pale crescent moon above one small curling wave. Color theme: deep blue and aqua water with white foam; healing in soft green. Chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bold readable silhouettes, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art UI icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, one icon centered per grid cell on magenta. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
